title.zh: 发音器官位置汇总：MOCHA-TIMIT 和 USC-TIMIT 电磁发音仪（EMA）按音素的均值
title.en: Articulator position summary: per-phone means from MOCHA-TIMIT and USC-TIMIT electromagnetic articulography (EMA)

_doc.zh: 本文件只有我们自己算出的汇总量（均值、标准差、个数），没有逐帧轨迹，也没有音频。原始数据留在本机 data/raw/reference/mocha-timit/，不入库。用途：校对视位表里的下颌开度、唇开度、唇前伸和舌位——这些数值目前都是假设。两位说话人（一女一男，英格兰南部口音，朗读句子），样本很小，只能当作量级和相对次序的参照。未经专业人员审校。 另有 USC-TIMIT 的一位美式英语男性说话人（M1），放在 uscTimit 一节，算法相同。
_doc.en: This file holds only aggregates computed by this project (means, SDs, counts): no per-frame trajectory and no audio. The raw data stay on the local machine under data/raw/reference/mocha-timit/ and are not committed. Purpose: to check the jaw opening, lip aperture, lip protrusion and tongue positions of the viseme table, all of which are assumptions today. Two speakers (one female, one male, Southern English, read sentences): a very small sample, usable for magnitudes and relative order only. Not reviewed by a specialist. One American English male speaker (M1) of USC-TIMIT is added under uscTimit, computed the same way.

zh: EMA 文件是 Edinburgh Speech Tools 的 Track 格式，500 Hz；我们的假设：数值单位是 1/100 mm（按此换算后，双唇闭合时上下唇线圈相距 18–23 mm、/a/ 的切牙开度约 6 mm，量级合理；发行包里的说明没有写单位）。
标注用发行包自带的 .lab（强制对齐，说明里写有约 6% 的转写错误）；两位说话人的音素序列相同。
每个音段取中间三分之一的帧求平均；短于 20 ms 的音段不用。
所有位置都减去上切牙线圈（ui）的位置，前后方向以“舌背到唇”为前，上下方向以“下切牙到上切牙”为上。
jawOpenMm：下切牙线圈（li）相对上切牙线圈的高度，比该说话人说话时达到的最高位置（第 95 百分位）低多少。它是切牙处的开度变化，不是髁突转角，也不是相对咬合位的绝对开口度。
lipApertureMm：上下唇线圈的距离，减去该说话人 /p b m/ 中点处该距离的中位数（线圈贴在唇红缘外，所以闭唇时距离不为零）。
lipProtrusionMm：上下唇线圈的前后位置均值，减去该说话人全部音段的中位数；正值向前。
舌的三个线圈（舌尖 tt、舌面 tb、舌背 td）给出相对上切牙线圈的坐标：X 向前为正，Y 向上为正。
按视位汇总时，把视位表里列出的音素对应到 MOCHA 标签（见 labelMap），把这些音段合在一起求平均；measuredJawRelativeToAA 是该视位的 jawOpenMm 除以同一说话人 AA 视位的值，再对两位说话人取平均，用来和视位表里 jaw 的相对大小比较。
en: The EMA files are Edinburgh Speech Tools tracks at 500 Hz; our assumption: the values are in 1/100 mm (with that conversion the lip coils are 18-23 mm apart at bilabial closure and the incisor opening of /a/ is about 6 mm, which is plausible; the documentation in the distribution does not state the unit).
Labels are the .lab files shipped with the data (forced alignment; the readme reports about 6 % transcription errors); both speakers have the same phone sequences.
Each segment is represented by the mean of the frames in its middle third; segments shorter than 20 ms are dropped.
All positions are taken relative to the upper-incisor coil (ui); anterior is the direction from tongue dorsum to lips and up is the direction from lower to upper incisor.

jawOpenMm: how far the lower-incisor coil (li), relative to the upper-incisor coil, is below the highest position that speaker reaches in speech (95th percentile). It is the change of incisor separation, not a condylar angle and not an absolute opening from occlusion.

lipApertureMm: distance between the upper-lip and lower-lip coils minus that speaker's median distance at the midpoint of /p b m/ (the coils sit outside the vermilion border, so the distance is not zero when the lips are closed).
lipProtrusionMm: mean anterior position of the two lip coils minus that speaker's median over all segments; positive is forward.
The three tongue coils (tip tt, body tb, dorsum td) are given as coordinates relative to the upper-incisor coil: X positive forward, Y positive up.

Per viseme, the phonemes listed in the viseme table are mapped to MOCHA labels (see labelMap) and their segments pooled; measuredJawRelativeToAA is that viseme's jawOpenMm divided by the same speaker's value for the AA viseme, averaged over the two speakers, for comparison with the relative size of jaw in the viseme table.

zh: 只有两位说话人，都是英式发音：MOCHA 的 o（LOT）是圆唇的 [ɒ]，映射到 ARPAbet 的 aa 只是近似；uu（GOOSE）在英格兰南部口音里偏前、圆唇弱，所以测到的唇前伸很小。
朗读连续语句里的开口度比单念音节小得多；视位表若按夸张或单念的口型定，数值会更大。
唇前伸只有约 ±1.5 mm 的变化范围，接近线圈定位和头部固定的误差，次序可参考，绝对值不可靠。
没有汉语普通话的发音器官数据；找到的普通话 EMA 语料都要付费或申请。
en: Only two speakers, both British: MOCHA o (LOT) is the rounded [ɒ], so mapping it to ARPAbet aa is approximate; uu (GOOSE) is fronted and weakly rounded in Southern English, hence the small measured protrusion.
Openings in read connected speech are much smaller than in isolated syllables; a viseme table tuned for exaggerated or citation-form shapes would have larger values.
Lip protrusion varies over only about ±1.5 mm, close to the error of coil placement and head fixation: the order is informative, the absolute values are not reliable.
No articulatory data for Mandarin: the Mandarin EMA corpora found are paid or by application.

note.zh: MOCHA 标签 → 视位表用的 ARPAbet 记号；没列出的标签原样使用。
note.en: MOCHA label -> ARPAbet symbol used by the viseme table; labels not listed are used as they are.

source.name: USC-TIMIT: Real-time magnetic resonance imaging and electromagnetic articulography database for speech production research (Narayanan et al. 2014, J Acoust Soc Am 136(3), doi:10.1121/1.4890284), EMA part, speaker M1
source.licence: CC BY 4.0 (Zenodo record licence id cc-by-4.0)

note.zh: 只取了 M1 的 EMA 轨迹（.mat，100 Hz，单位 mm）和音素对齐（.trans）；另外三位说话人和全部 MRI 没有下载（Zenodo 的分段下载很慢）。
note.en: Only the EMA trajectories (.mat, 100 Hz, in mm) and phone alignments (.trans) of M1 were fetched; the other three EMA speakers and all MRI were not downloaded (ranged downloads from Zenodo are slow).

method.zh: 同上：每个音段取中间三分之一的帧。jawOpenMm 用 JAW 线圈的竖直坐标，相对该说话人说话时的最高位置（第 95 百分位）；lipApertureMm、lipProtrusionMm 的定义同上。舌的坐标是语料自己的头部坐标系（X 向前、Y 向上），原点和 MOCHA 的不同，两个语料的舌位绝对值不能直接比较。标注是语料自带的 ARPAbet 对齐，没有换算。
method.en: As above: the middle third of each segment. jawOpenMm uses the vertical coordinate of the JAW coil relative to the highest position the speaker reaches in speech (95th percentile); lipApertureMm and lipProtrusionMm are defined as above. Tongue coordinates are in the corpus's own head frame (X forward, Y up) whose origin differs from MOCHA's, so absolute tongue positions of the two corpora are not directly comparable. Labels are the ARPAbet alignments shipped with the corpus, unchanged.

zh: 这位说话人的标注里 ah 同时用于重读的 STRUT 元音和非重读的弱化元音，所以 AA 视位（aa、ay、aw、ah）的均值被大量弱化元音拉低；比较开口度请看 perPhone 里的 aa、ae、ay、aw。
这位说话人发双唇音时下颌并不高（PBM 的 jawOpenMm 约 3.6 mm），和 MOCHA 两位说话人（约 2 mm）不同：个体差异大。
en: In this speaker's labels ah covers both the stressed STRUT vowel and unstressed reduced vowels, so the mean of the AA viseme (aa, ay, aw, ah) is pulled down by many reduced vowels; for jaw opening compare aa, ae, ay and aw under perPhone.
This speaker does not raise the jaw much for bilabials (jawOpenMm about 3.6 mm for PBM) unlike the two MOCHA speakers (about 2 mm): individual differences are large.
